newsitem.title: USA: Intl Franchise expects profitability in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Intl Franchise expects profitability in Q3.

text.p: International Franchise Systems Inc said Wednesday it expects to show improved profitability and set records in system sales and revenues for the third quarter of 1996.
In a release Wednesday, the company said that income earned in the first two months of the quarter exceeded income of the same period last year.

Initiatives to focus on the core business and cost-cutting measures have started to contribute to improved earnings, International Franchise said, adding that the company is "now doing the right things to improve earnings" and that it "has always shown significant sales growth."
